#### 1. bone marrow failure syndrome 5  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.723)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-2559584, Reactome:R-HSA-2559586, Reactome:R-HSA-390471, Reactome:R-HSA-5693565, Reactome:R-HSA-6785807)

Loss-of-function mutations in TP53 disrupt the DNA damage response pathway. This disruption leads to impaired cellular processes, resulting in increased susceptibility to cancer (Li-Fraumeni syndrome 1) and bone marrow failure (bone marrow failure syndrome 5).

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in TP53 with a consistent gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect in both Li-Fraumeni syndrome 1 and bone marrow failure syndrome 5, or the complete absence of TP53 variants in individuals diagnosed with both conditions. _(variant: rs112905480)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of TP53 in these distinct syndromes highlights potential therapeutic avenues targeting the DNA damage response pathway or downstream effectors that could benefit patients with either condition.
